title: At the restaurant
summary: Read a menu, order a meal and make sound plurals with -ūna and -āt.
intro: Many Arabic plurals are made by adding an ending. For groups of men (or mixed groups) add ـُونَ: طَبَّاخ (cook) becomes طَبَّاخُونَ (cooks). For women, and for many things, drop ة and add ـَات: سَلَطَة becomes سَلَطَات (salads), مَشْرُوب becomes مَشْرُوبَات (drinks). These are the sound plurals: the singular stays whole, and only an ending is added.
objectives: Name ten things on a restaurant menu
Order a main dish and a drink in a restaurant
Make the plural of people with ـُونَ and ـِينَ
Make the plural of things with ـَات and give it a feminine adjective

realLife.title: Dinner with the teacher
realLife.story: To celebrate Daniel's first weeks at the school, Mr Karim takes Daniel, Layla and Sami to a famous restaurant in Cairo. The menu is long, the cooks are famous, and Daniel, who doesn't eat much meat, has to find something vegetarian.

sentences.en: The cooks in this restaurant are Egyptian.
sentences.literal: the cooks in this restaurant (are) Egyptians

mistakes.why: The cooks are several people, so the adjective takes the plural ending -ūna too.

sentences.en: We have salads and cold drinks.
sentences.literal: at us (are) salads and drinks cold

mistakes.why: -ūna is only for people. The plural of things takes a feminine singular adjective: bārida.

sentences.ar: أُرِيدُ دَجَاجًا مَعَ الْأَرُزّ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
sentences.en: I'd like chicken with rice, please.
sentences.literal: I want chicken with the rice, from your kindness

mistakes.why: After a preposition (here لِـ, 'to') and after a verb, -ūna becomes -īna.

dialogue.title: Dinner with Mr Karim
dialogue.culture: Egyptian restaurants often bring bread, pickles and small salads to the table before the meal. Fish from the Red Sea and the Mediterranean is very popular. You call a waiter with لَوْ سَمَحْتَ, and whoever invites usually pays for everyone.

lines.ar: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْر! طَاوِلَة لِأَرْبَعَة أَشْخَاص؟ تَفَضَّلُوا، هٰذِهِ الْقَائِمَة.
lines.en: Good evening! A table for four people? Please sit down, here is the menu.
segs: please, here you are (to several people)

lines.ar: شُكْرًا! يَا طُلَّاب، هٰذَا الْمَطْعَم مَشْهُور، وَالطَّبَّاخُونَ هُنَا مُمْتَازُونَ.
lines.en: Thank you! Students, this restaurant is famous, and the cooks here are excellent.

lines.ar: الْقَائِمَة طَوِيلَة جِدًّا! فِيهَا سَلَطَات وَلُحُوم وَسَمَك وَمَشْرُوبَات.
lines.en: The menu is very long! It has salads, meat dishes, fish and drinks.

lines.ar: يَا أُسْتَاذ، مَاذَا تَأْكُلُ أَنْتَ عَادَةً فِي هٰذَا الْمَطْعَم؟
lines.en: Teacher, what do you usually eat in this restaurant yourself?

lines.ar: آكُلُ الدَّجَاجَ الْمَشْوِيَّ مَعَ الْأَرُزّ. هُوَ أَطْيَبُ طَبَق هُنَا.
lines.en: I eat the grilled chicken with rice. It is the best dish here.

lines.ar: هَلْ أَنْتُمْ جَاهِزُونَ؟ مَاذَا تُرِيدُونَ، مِنْ فَضْلِكُمْ؟
lines.en: Are you all ready? What would you like, please?

lines.ar: أُرِيدُ دَجَاجًا مَشْوِيًّا مَعَ الْأَرُزّ، وَسَلَطَةً خَضْرَاء.
lines.en: I'd like grilled chicken with rice, and a green salad.

lines.ar: وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ سَمَكًا. هَلِ السَّمَك طَازَج الْيَوْم؟
lines.en: And I'd like fish. Is the fish fresh today?

lines.ar: طَبْعًا! السَّمَك طَازَج كُلَّ يَوْم، مِنَ الْبَحْر الْأَحْمَر.
lines.en: Of course! The fish is fresh every day, from the Red Sea.

lines.ar: أَنَا لَا آكُلُ اللَّحْمَ كَثِيرًا. هَلْ عِنْدَكُمْ طَعَام نَبَاتِيّ؟
lines.en: I don't eat much meat. Do you have any vegetarian food?

lines.ar: نَعَم، عِنْدَنَا مَحْشِي وَمُسَقَّعَة وَسَلَطَات كَثِيرَة.
lines.en: Yes, we have stuffed vegetables, aubergine moussaka and lots of salads.

lines.ar: إِذَنْ أُرِيدُ الْمَحْشِيَّ، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، وَمَاءً لِلْجَمِيع.
lines.en: Then I'd like the stuffed vegetables, please, and water for everyone.

lines.ar: وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ لَحْمًا مَشْوِيًّا مَعَ الْأَرُزّ. أَنَا جَائِع جِدًّا!
lines.en: And I'd like grilled meat with rice. I am really hungry!

lines.ar: كَيْفَ الطَّعَام يَا طُلَّاب؟ هَلْ هُوَ لَذِيذ؟
lines.en: How is the food, students? Is it tasty?

lines.ar: السَّمَك لَذِيذ جِدًّا، وَالسَّلَطَات طَازَجَة. شُكْرًا يَا أُسْتَاذ!
lines.en: The fish is delicious, and the salads are fresh. Thank you, teacher!

lines.ar: الْعَفْوْ! لَوْ سَمَحْتَ، الْحِسَاب. الْيَوْم أَنَا أَدْفَعُ!
lines.en: Not at all! Excuse me, the bill, please. Today I'm paying!

reading.title: A famous restaurant
reading.ar: فِي الْمَسَاء يَأْكُلُ الطُّلَّاب فِي مَطْعَم مَشْهُور. الْأُسْتَاذ كَرِيم يَأْكُلُ دَجَاجًا مَعَ الْأَرُزّ، وَلَيْلَى تَأْكُلُ سَمَكًا. الطَّبَّاخُونَ مُمْتَازُونَ، وَالسَّلَطَات طَازَجَة. الْمَشْرُوبَات بَارِدَة أَيْضًا.
reading.en: In the evening the students eat at a famous restaurant. Mr Karim eats chicken with rice, and Layla eats fish. The cooks are excellent, and the salads are fresh. The drinks are cold too.
segs: eat (the verb stays singular before its subject)

quiz.prompt: Which word is the plural of طَبَّاخ (cook)?
Choose the correct sentence: 'The drinks are cold.'
Which letter is an emphatic consonant?

completion: Great work! You can order a meal in a restaurant and make sound plurals. Tomorrow: saying what you like and don't like.
